fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6T1ZR, no owner present. The planner read internal/api/usage_learn.go, usage_hold.go, internal/usage and the live daemon state: both learned limits (session 2353388, weekly 21870750) came from usage-fake test hits at 2026-11-04T10:45Z leaked into the root's usage.limits.jsonl, one of them with a 4-day reset, so the code's one-kind-per-hit rule held; the leak is change set 01M6T20E's. The planner asked four questions (which intent to serve, what to do about the both-kinds point, how learned limits relearn, how live runs count); the arbiter answered with Decision usage-governor-limits-fix-scope: serve m29-one-daemon; only a regression test for the both-kinds point; learned limits ratchet up to a window's use when it passes them with no hit in the window, settings never change; each live run adds max(0, run mean - its tokens so far) and the new pick one full mean. Three leaves follow. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Usage governor limits fix, autonomous plan
